name: qwen-face-swap-v0
purpose: Determine whether generic two-image Qwen editing can perform a recognizable face-identity swap while preserving target composition and body morphology.

input_protocol.image_2: clothed synthetic adult portrait: face identity

decision_rule: Pass when source_identity_transfer, target_scene_preservation, face_boundary_quality, and instruction_adherence are at least 4; target_body_preservation and target_pose_preservation are 5; and artifact_severity is at most 2.
fallback: If Qwen fails identity transfer or alters target morphology, evaluate a dedicated swap backend. ReActor is not the default candidate because its current upstream implementation includes an NSFW detector; keep backend selection replaceable.
conclusion: Reject this fixed-seed result as a controlled face-identity swap. Body and pose preservation do not compensate for weak identity transfer and unauthorized hair changes.
